There was at least one '''[[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]''' that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Phaeda/Legends|Phaeda]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. The [[Phaeda Militia]] was recruited from here and almost as soon as [[Zayne Carrick]] had reached the spaceport when on his way to see his [[Carrick family|family]], he was drafted into the militia.
